de.abas.ceks.jedp

Class EDPLockBehavior

  • Object
    • EDPLockBehavior
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class EDPLockBehavior
extends Object
implements Serializable
    This class contains information regarding the lock behavior of EDP. This includes the type of behavior (wait indefinitely, wait for a certain time or do not wait at all. The wait time can be given in seconds (approximately).
    Since:
    abas Version 2005r0, EDP Version 3.14
    Version:
    1
    Author:

    • Field Detail

      • WAITINFINITE

        public static final int WAITINFINITE
        When a lock request is being blocked, system waits until the blocking lock has been released. This is the default behavior.
        See Also:
        EDPLockBehavior(int), Constant Field Values

      • WAIT

        public static final int WAIT
        When a lock request is being blocked, system waits at most a certain wait time. After the wait time has elapsed, the lock request is being aborted. A wait time of 0 means "wait indefinitely" an therefore is equivalent to WAITINFINITE.
        See Also:
        WAITINFINITE, EDPLockBehavior(int,int), Constant Field Values

      • NOWAIT

        public static final int NOWAIT
        When a lock request is being blocked, system does not wait at all. The lock request is being aborted immediately.
        See Also:
        EDPLockBehavior(int), Constant Field Values

      • LOCKBEHAVIOR_WAITINFINITE

        public static final EDPLockBehavior LOCKBEHAVIOR_WAITINFINITE
        Constant instance for "wait infinitely".

      • LOCKBEHAVIOR_NOWAIT

        public static final EDPLockBehavior LOCKBEHAVIOR_NOWAIT
        Constant instance for "don't wait".
